name: SourceBundle
description: A bundle of source references that grounds a note, summary, action, or suggestion.

id.description: Stable host source-bundle id for evidence references; distinct from the AST block id.

revision.description: Non-negative bundle revision. Increment when the bundle membership or locators change.

source_hash.description: Host-computed digest of the exact source revision set when available.

confidence.description: Grounding confidence from 0.0 to 1.0 when applicable.

validation: id must be unique within the document
revision must be a non-negative integer when present
the same id and revision must identify the same bundle membership and locators
children must resolve to concrete source refs or draft source resolution issues
scope must be allowed by the current document and user scope
